title: A Glyph Is Not a Letter, a Token Is Not a Word, a Space Is Not a Space: What the Units of Voynichese Are Not
abstract: arXiv:2608.17096v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The Voynich manuscript (Beinecke MS 408) is usually analysed on three unstated assumptions: that its glyphs are letters, that the strings between blanks are words, and that every blank is a word space. We test all three against the Zandbergen-Landini transliteration with matched prose, cipher, and pseudo-text controls and quire-level resampling. None holds, and the failures share a shape: the order in Voynichese sits at the edges of tokens and at graded boundaries between them, not in the succession of tokens themselves. Glyph regularity is too strong for one-to-one substitution of any tested plaintext (conditional entropy 2.7 bits against about 3.5 for Latin, Italian, and English) and resolves instead onto a quire-stable scale of recurrent multi-symbol units. Tokens form a plausible vocabulary, yet the identity of one token predicts the next by under 1% of token entropy, below every matched control (2-10%), while the glyphs at token edg

translated_title: 字形不是字母，标记不是单词，空格不是空格：沃伊尼克手稿单位不是什么
translated_abstract: 沃伊尼克手稿（Beinecke MS 408）通常基于三个未言明的假设进行分析：其字形是字母，空白之间的字符串是单词，每个空白都是单词间隔。我们使用Zandbergen-Landini转写文本，并配以匹配的散文、密码和伪文本对照，以及按卷册重新抽样，对这三个假设进行了检验。结果发现，没有一个假设成立，且这些失败具有共同特征：沃伊尼克语中的顺序位于标记的边缘以及它们之间的分级边界上，而非标记本身的序列中。字形规则性过强，无法与任何测试明文进行一对一替换（条件熵为2.7比特，而拉丁语、意大利语和英语约为3.5比特），反而解析为一个卷册稳定的多符号重复单元尺度。标记构成了一个合理的词汇表，但一个标记对下一个标记的预测仅占标记熵的不到1%，低于所有匹配对照（2-10%），而标记边缘的字形...
tldr: 本文通过严格统计检验推翻了沃伊尼克手稿的三个基本假设（字形为字母、空白间为单词、空白为词间隔），发现其结构特征在于标记边缘和分级边界，而非传统语言单位序列。
en_tdlr: This paper refutes three fundamental assumptions about the Voynich manuscript (glyphs as letters, blank-separated strings as words, blanks as word spaces) through rigorous statistical tests, revealing that its structure lies at token edges and graded boundaries rather than in conventional linguistic unit sequences.
